summary: Iceberg community activity this week focused on specification clarifications for REST catalogs and table specs, patch release planning for 1.10.2 and PyIceberg-core 0.9.1, and ongoing feature development including efficient column updates, relative path support, and fine-grained read restrictions. The community also discussed Spark 4.1/4.2 integration improvements and Comet's shift toward iceberg-rust.
highlights: REST Catalog spec discussions on 404 responses and identifier uniqueness across object types
Relative path support proposal for v4 table spec addressing location mutability
Efficient column updates POC development with focus on partial updates and compaction strategies
Spark 4.1/4.2 support and async reader improvements for small file workloads
